paintings.title: Evening Prayers at the Ghats of Varanasi, with Floating Diyas on the Ganga and Temple Bells in the Distance
paintings.description: Oil on canvas, 90 x 120 cm. A wide evening scene of the Ganga aarti, with rows of floating diyas, boats near the steps, and temple spires fading into the haze. This long description is here on purpose, so that your layout is tested with a lot of text.

paintings.title: The Reading Room at Dusk
paintings.description: A miniature-inspired study in walnut, plum and moss, painted with the hush of a library after sundown. Gouache and mineral pigment on paper, 42 x 58 cm.

paintings.title: Night-Blooming Jasmine
paintings.description: A fragrant branch held in a brass vase, set against an espresso ground. Tempera and gold leaf on board, 45 x 60 cm.

paintings.title: The Last Light at Udaipur
paintings.description: A still lake, palace silhouettes and the last saffron light of day. Oil on linen, 60 x 80 cm.
